Content.LocalizedString: Free this afternoon for a drink?
thinking.jpg
confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 可以是可以……不过怎么这么突然？
Content.LocalizedString: I mean, I could… but why so sudden?
And why in the afternoon…?

Content.SourceString: 闲着也是闲着，不如找点乐子。
Content.LocalizedString: Since I've got nothing better to do, might as well find some fun.

Content.SourceString: 顺便，你也多放松一下自己如何？
Content.LocalizedString: Why don't you loosen up a little too?

Content.SourceString: 紧绷绷的，我看着你都没劲。
Content.LocalizedString: You're so uptight, it's draining just looking at you.

Content.SourceString: 错觉，是你的错觉。我很有精神！
Content.LocalizedString: That's just your imagination. I'm plenty energetic!
shocked.jpg
Stop pretending. That won't work on me.

Content.SourceString: 原来法帝娅小姐这么敏锐！
Content.LocalizedString: I had no idea you were so perceptive!

Content.SourceString: 有什么心事不妨跟我说说，说不定我能给你找点发泄的法子~？
Content.LocalizedString: If something's bothering you, why not tell me about it? I might just know a way to help you relax.
It's really nothing important.

Content.SourceString: 只是偶尔有些焦虑，我对自己几乎还是一无所知……
Content.LocalizedString: I just get anxious sometimes… I still know almost nothing about myself…

Content.SourceString: 但是一想到未来哪天将要知道自己是谁、来自哪里，又感到莫名的害怕。
Content.LocalizedString: But whenever I think about someday finding out who I really am and where I came from… I feel this strange fear come over me.

Content.SourceString: 觉得这样矛盾的自己也很奇怪。
Content.LocalizedString: I know it's strange to feel so conflicted about this.

Content.SourceString: 呃，居然是这么沉重的话题。
Content.LocalizedString: Well, that took a heavier turn than expected.
(Message recalled)
Don't overthink it.

Content.SourceString: 「对待生命不妨大胆冒险一点，因为好歹你要失去它的。」
Content.LocalizedString: "Take some bold risks with your life. After all, you're going to lose it anyway."
If you want to relieve some stress…

Can't see the message
You might get us banned
Well then… I'll just have to tell you in person later.
Don't worry, this one's on me.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，有兴趣做套性格测试题吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, interested in taking a little personality quiz?

Content.SourceString: 很快，就几个问题。我想多了解了解你呢~
Content.LocalizedString: It'll be quick, just a few questions. I'd like to get to know you better.
noproblem.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你喜欢喝小猫奶茶铺的哪款饮品？
Content.LocalizedString: Which drink do you prefer from the kitty milk tea shop?

Content.SourceString: 猫猫猛锤荔浦芋头布丁奶茶
Content.LocalizedString: Nyanko Punch Taro Pudding Milktea
Nyanko Cozy Uji Matcha
Hmm… I see now.

Content.SourceString: 下一题。你喜欢雨天还是晴天？
Content.LocalizedString: Next question. Do you prefer rainy days or sunny ones?
Rainy
Sunny

Content.SourceString: 雨后青草的涩味、潮湿又柔和的气息，还有均衡的落雨声……都很令人着迷。
Content.LocalizedString: The tangy scent of wet grass, that humid yet gentle air, and the steady rhythm of falling rain… it's all so captivating.

Content.SourceString: 坏心情会被一扫而空的感觉？嗯……和外壳完美剥落的栗子一样清爽，不错。
Content.LocalizedString: That feeling when bad moods just vanish into thin air? Hmm… it's as refreshing as a chestnut perfectly peeled from its shell. I like that.
What a peculiar metaphor…

Content.SourceString: 下一题。周末喜欢干什么？
Content.LocalizedString: Next question. What do you like to do on weekends?

OptionText.LocalizedString: I need work, gotta find a job!

Content.LocalizedString: Go out and have fun
Stay at home
I need work, gotta find a job!

Content.SourceString: 噢？我会从现在就开始计算你来找我的次数。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? I'll start keeping count of every time you come looking for me from now on.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……也行。一会儿把你家地址发我。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… that works too. Just send me your address later.

Content.SourceString: ……伊波恩这么不人道？要不要考虑来我们E.T.D啊？
Content.LocalizedString: …Is Eibon really that inhumane? Why not consider joining us at ETD instead?

Content.SourceString: 再下题！喜欢米饭还是面条？
Content.LocalizedString: Another question! Do you prefer rice or noodles?
Rice
Noodles

Content.SourceString: 小孩才做选择，我全都要
Content.LocalizedString: Only children make choices, I want it all
Well… that brings us to the final question.
Which kind of egg do you prefer?
Soft-boiled egg (Type A)
Soy-braised egg (Type B)
Fried egg (Type C)
Looks like the results are in.
Looks like the results are in.
Looks like the results are in.
excited.jpg
excited.jpg
excited.jpg

Content.SourceString: A型：说明你喜欢吃水煮蛋。
Content.LocalizedString: Type A: This indicates you prefer soft-boiled eggs.
Type B: This indicates you prefer soy-braised eggs.
Type C: This indicates you prefer fried eggs.

Content.SourceString: 人在无语的时候真的会笑。
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes you really do laugh when you have no words.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哎呀，真有意思。
Content.LocalizedString: Hahahahaha, oh my, how amusing.

Content.SourceString: 下一个找谁呢，我想想……找大狗吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Now, who should I pick next? Let me think… How about the big dog!
See you around, Appraiser.
Hey.
hello.jpg
And you are?

Content.SourceString: 回应这么冷漠？人家可是会伤心的。
Content.LocalizedString: What's with the cold response? You're going to break my heart, you know.

Content.SourceString: 你是管理局大厅里，白藏队长身边的那位。
Content.LocalizedString: You're the one who was with Captain Baicang in the Bureau.
What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 非得有事才能找你吗~好没情趣哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Do I need a reason to see you? How unromantic of you.

Content.SourceString: 我们好歹也有过一面之缘呢。
Content.LocalizedString: We've at least had the pleasure of meeting once before, haven't we?

Content.SourceString: 确实。以后我可能也要经常和管理局的大家打交道。
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed. I'll probably be working with everyone at the Bureau quite often from now on.

Content.SourceString: 一面之缘就那么热情的话……
Content.LocalizedString: Being so enthusiastic after meeting just once…

Content.SourceString: 如果有麻烦到法帝娅小姐的地方，请多多担待~
Content.LocalizedString: If I've troubled you in any way, Fadia, please forgive my imposition.
Isn't this a bit too strange…
servingtea.jpg
My, why so formal?

Content.SourceString: 放松点——他们叫你什么来着？鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: Relax a bit. What do they call you again? The Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 总之，这是我的联系方式。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, here's my contact.

Content.SourceString: 想我的话，欢迎随时来找我~
Content.LocalizedString: If you find yourself missing me, come see me anytime.

Content.SourceString: 我们可以一起去做些有意思的事。
Content.LocalizedString: We could do something fun together.
What kind of fun?
Alright, I'll come see you when I'm free.

Content.SourceString: 先说好，五星好市民不会做违法乱纪的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Just to be clear, a model citizen like myself doesn't engage in illegal activities.
Hmm… what could it be?
blowingkiss.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，晚上去ARPTS喝一杯吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, want to grab a drink at A.R.P.T.S tonight?

Content.SourceString: 最近办了不少案子，需要酒精犒劳一下自己。
Content.LocalizedString: I've been handling quite a few cases lately, so I need some alcohol to reward myself.
You've been working hard, time to relax!

Content.SourceString: 温馨提示——跟我喝酒可能会听到秘密，也可能被套出秘密……风险自负哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Fair warning: drinking with me might mean you'll hear secrets… or spill your own. Drink at your own risk.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I can drink anyone under the table.

Content.SourceString: 我酒量还不错，会随时保持清醒的。
Content.LocalizedString: I have a pretty good tolerance, so I'll stay clear-headed the whole time.

Content.SourceString: 我不确定……喝醉后会不会胡言乱语。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not sure… I might start rambling nonsense when I'm drunk.
Hmm… what a shame.

Content.SourceString: 唔，我能想象鉴定师喝醉后的样子，一定很可爱。
Content.LocalizedString: Mm, I can just picture what you'd look like drunk, Appraiser. I bet you'd be adorable.
Excellent.
Excellent.
Uh… So what time should we meet?
<Red>10 PM, A.R.P.T.S</>. Don't keep me waiting.
<Red>10 PM, A.R.P.T.S</>. Don't keep me waiting.

Content.SourceString: 今天天气真好，鉴定师，出来晒太阳吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Beautiful day today, Appraiser. Want to come out and soak up some sun?

Content.SourceString: 这样好的天气，确实不该浪费。
Content.LocalizedString: Weather this nice really shouldn't go to waste.

Content.SourceString: 那就去水菱湖步道吧，那儿的樱花开得正盛。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's go to the Caltrop Lake walkway then. The cherry blossoms are in full bloom there.
Alright, see you in a bit.
Alright, see you in a bit.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，能陪我去趟家具店吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, could you come with me to the furniture store?

Content.SourceString: 前几天和异象战斗的时候，一不小心，把市民的家给拆了~
Content.LocalizedString: A few days ago when I was fighting an Anomaly, I accidentally demolished some citizen's house.
Acci… dentally?
Surprised

Content.SourceString: 哎呀，打架时哪顾得上这些？当然是要先玩得尽兴嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh come on, who has time to worry about that stuff during a fight? Of course I had to have my fun first!

Content.SourceString: 总之，我已经和房主人承诺过了，所有损失都会记在我的账上。
Content.LocalizedString: Anyway, I already promised the homeowner that all the damages would go on my tab.

Content.SourceString: 为表歉意，再去家具店挑选几件家具送给她吧~
Content.LocalizedString: To further make up for it, how about we head to the furniture store and pick out a few pieces for her?
Alright, I'll head out now then.

Content.SourceString: 那在诺提克桥附近的家具店碰头哦？
Content.LocalizedString: So we'll meet up at the furniture store near Noetic Bridge?
I'm almost there. Wait for me.
I'm almost there. Wait for me.
